questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes Automated Testing?
options: Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
Automated tests should be discovered and run reproducibly, with failures propagated and machine-readable reports retained where useful.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
questions.answer_key: Automated tests should be discovered and run reproducibly, with failures propagated and machine-readable reports retained where useful.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of automated testing: Automated tests should be discovered and run reproducibly, with failures propagated and machine-readable reports retained where useful. Validate configuration and behavior against the current official reference before production use.

questions.prompt: A team is working with “Unit tests”. Which practice best fits this topic?
options: Make the check deterministic and fail with a meaningful status when requirements are not met. Preserve reports where useful and configure required branch checks to match the checks the workflow actually emits.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
questions.answer_key: Make the check deterministic and fail with a meaningful status when requirements are not met. Preserve reports where useful and configure required branch checks to match the checks the workflow actually emits.
questions.explanation: Unit tests: Make the check deterministic and fail with a meaningful status when requirements are not met. Preserve reports where useful and configure required branch checks to match the checks the workflow actually emits. Apply the guidance to the actual event, runner, permissions, or artifact boundary and test the relevant case.

questions.prompt: How should a reviewer verify a change related to automated testing?
options: Retry every failure without looking at the exit code or preserving evidence.
Publish the workflow to production before reviewing its triggers and permissions.
Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
Assume the workflow is correct as soon as the YAML file is committed.
questions.answer_key: Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
questions.explanation: Reliable verification uses observable evidence. For this lesson, consider: Automated tests should be discovered and run reproducibly, with failures propagated and machine-readable reports retained where useful. A syntax check alone cannot prove remote execution, permissions, or deployment behavior.
